# Page templates

Copy one of these files to start a new page. This folder starts with `_`, so Docusaurus does not publish it.

| Template | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| `how-to.md` | Steps to reach one goal |
| `concept.md` | Explaining how something works |
| `reference.md` | Lists of settings, keys or API members |
| `new-feature.md` | A New Feature page for one IDEMPIERE ticket |
| `plugin.md` | A page in Available Plugins |
| `migration-note.md` | A breaking change or removed API in a release |

Replace every `<placeholder>`, delete sections that do not apply, and follow the [Documentation standards](https://docs.idempiere.org/docs/documentation-standards).
